verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a TLD price list endpoint covering 'all TLDs supported by name.com' with pricing tiers, implying broad TLD coverage, but there is no evidence of per-TLD documentation of special requirements (restricted TLDs, ccTLD rules, local presence, etc.). Missing for 10: explicit TLD count/list, documented restricted-TLD or ccTLD requirement pages, and any special-requirement disclosures per extension.
